fields.geographic_focus: Haiti. HQ in Port-au-Prince (Ouest department) with fiber and 4G LTE coverage across Port-au-Prince and provincial cities including Cap-Haitien, Port-de-Paix, Gonaives, Jacmel, Les Cayes and Jeremie, reaching a population of roughly 3-5 million.
fields.provisioning_landscape: Access Haiti builds and operates its own fiber and 4G LTE access networks and sells dedicated internet, VoIP, VPN and managed WiFi to corporate, government, SME and residential customers. Connectivity is provisioned through its own access plant plus regional wholesale and submarine-cable transit partnerships, with no evidence of a self-service or programmatic fabric. Private, deterministic onward paths to cloud or partner endpoints are a manual gap fulfilled via point-to-point circuits.

Advanced Stream Broadband is a small regional fiber and cable ISP serving Tacoma and the South Puget Sound (University Place, Fircrest, Fife, Lakewood, Puyallup) plus several Utah communities, riding the municipal Click! Network plant for last-mile. It provisions residential and small-business broadband, phone and fiber service via manual ticket-and-truck-roll workflows rather than any programmatic interconnect. There is no self-service fabric, so deterministic private paths to cloud or enterprise endpoints would be a manual buildout.

Africell Angola is a licensed mobile network operator that owns and controls most of its ~700-tower 2G/3G/4G estate across Luanda, Benguela, Huila and Kwanza Sul, serving over five million subscribers with nationwide expansion targeted by 2027. Service activation runs through a carrier-grade OSS/BSS provisioning stack tuned for mobile and home-broadband subscribers. Deterministic private interconnect to clouds or enterprise sites is not a productized motion and would be handled as bespoke transport.

fields.provisioning_landscape: Africom is a Zimbabwean converged communications provider (since 1995) delivering integrated data, voice and video over broadband plus mobile services to about 100,000 customers. Programmatic private interconnect to cloud or partner endpoints is not offered and would be delivered as a manual circuit.

name: Airtel Seychelles

fields.provisioning_landscape: Airtel Seychelles is a small island mobile network operator (acquired from Telecom Seychelles in 2010) focused on prepaid/postpaid mobile, home broadband and enterprise plans across Mahe, Praslin and La Digue. As a small island MNO it has no programmatic interconnect fabric, so private deterministic paths off-island depend on submarine-cable transit and manual circuit delivery.

fields.provisioning_landscape: Aviso is the retail/ISP brand tied to Cote d'Ivoire Telecom, delivering fixed broadband (ADSL, fixed LTE, fiber-to-home) to Ivorian consumers and businesses, mostly around Abidjan. Deterministic private paths to cloud or partner endpoints are not a productized motion and would be provisioned manually over the incumbent transport.

BAM Broadband is a regional fiber and fixed-wireless operator (HQ Greenwood Village, CO; formed from DirectLink in Colorado and Desert iNet in Arizona) building FTTH and symmetrical service up to 8 Gbps across the South Denver and Phoenix/Scottsdale/Tempe metros. It provisions residential and business broadband through manual install and ticket workflows with no programmatic interconnect fabric. Deterministic private on-ramps to the AWS/Azure/GCP regions in its Denver and Phoenix footprint are a gap fulfilled by bespoke circuits.
